title: NIKE, Inc. Footwear Design Internship
note: For final-year students graduating Spring–Winter 2027 in footwear, fashion, industrial or product design; footwear portfolio required.

facts.summary: Paid 10-week footwear design internship at Nike World HQ with relocation help, mentored by senior designers and design directors.
facts.duties: Run a guided footwear project covering research, insights, performance and manufacturing problem solving, athlete input and a wide range of concepts.
facts.requirements: Final year of school, graduating Spring–Winter 2027; portfolio with 3–5 footwear-relevant projects; sketching, rendering, 2D technical drawing; materials/manufacturing knowledge; Photoshop, Illustrator, presentation tools.
facts.apply: Apply online through Nike's Workday careers posting.
